name: Forever Launcher
description: PS5 homebrew launcher for running Battle.net and World of Warcraft: Forever directly on a jailbroken PlayStation 5 through Wine and Vulkan. Supports the final WoW Forever channel as well as Classic beta, DirectX 12 through vkd3d-proton, DualSense controls, HDR, 4K output settings and frame generation using AMD FSR 3 or an optional user-supplied Lossless Scaling DLL. Battle.net and game files are downloaded separately and are not included in the package.
author: bizkut
